title: arundinella hispida
intro: Arundinella hispida, commonly known as the Hispid Hairgrass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in various parts of the world for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Arundinella hispida are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce swelling and protect the body from oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
